I've got the van on the books: **$30,000.00**, acquired March 2, 2026, coded to **Vehicles**. 1. **Useful life** — how many years the van will be in service. 5 years is the common default for a delivery van; 7–8 is defensible if you keep vehicles a long time.

|---|---|---|

Thanks,
[Me]
